run.the_bound_on_the_wait: first version: a search process still there 60 s after the searches' deadline (390 s after their start) is killed

what: development: the product's table reading, with the search stage in force and search processes that cannot stop a run, on invented laws beyond the conditions it was measured in (three inputs, noise up to 5 %). Not a result: nothing was fixed beforehand and one run is one draw

whether_it_stopped.reading: In every one of the 80 readings with four or five inputs one search process was sent the stop signal while alive; none with three inputs. 25 of the 80 never went and were killed by the watcher, each 333 to 346 s after its signal: the first version of the bound acts only at the searches' deadline plus a minute. Without the watcher each of the 25 would have stopped its shard for ever, as in run 2. No stall report, no process left over.
